scope: One sequential warm-cache cProfile CLI attempt each, reference main/bin+STATE main, candidate performance/bin+STATE agent497-state, CPUs0-11. No source edits. Diagnostic, not performance qualification.
timing_semantics: cProfile default timer records wrapper elapsed wall time. subprocess cumulative time, select.poll and time.sleep measure waiting, not wrapper CPU. GNU-time user/system includes child CPU and is not a per-function CPU profile. Inclusive cumulative times overlap and must not be summed.
verdict: No seconds-scale wrapper hashing regression identified. Repeated CLI-version probes are longstanding serial wrapper work (nine environment probes on both sides), while the newly confirmed generation bytecode mismatch is the immediate installation-regression repair target.

recommended_reduction.action: Reuse a freshly observed CLI major version solely for tool_env environment construction within the current attempt. Keep a fresh observation on entering each attempt.
recommended_reduction.why_supported: These nine calls repeat a serial external probe to choose identical KICAD10_SYMBOL_DIR/FOOTPRINT_DIR/TEMPLATE_DIR keys. The full command/tool version and drift evidence can continue to be collected at their existing authority boundaries.
preservation_constraints: No global tool-identity cache across attempts.
Do not replace source/module/package hashing or suppress manifest drift checks.
Do not remove required candidate/native DRC commands.
A second attempt, including one in the same process after a tool replacement, must perform a fresh observation.
Preserve fallback behavior for tool_env callers outside an attempt.
recommended_reduction.not_supported: Do not present summed call times as guaranteed wall savings or claim1.10qualification from this one profiled pair. No evidence here justifies optimizing Rust/search or weakening gates.
recommended_reduction.status: Deferred possible later optimization; do not broaden scope before bytecode-preparation fix and matrix evidence.

child_startup_boundary.observation: Reference has NumPy132/SciPy286/Shapely36cached bytecode files; candidate82/0/0. Missing caches are recompiled in numerical-routing child processes, which the wrapper cProfile cannot attribute to Python functions.
child_startup_boundary.limit: --help loads only part of SciPy; it does not quantify full routing-time lazy-import compilation. Full matrix after checked preparation-time compilation is required.
